record.reason: 一次要旨: We derive exact local responses for attention interventions, allowing candidate edits to be scored from a cached baseline and one backward pass. The starting point is the RoPE derivative $\partial_p z(p) = A z(p)$: its integral gives the finite positional displacement, which we carry through the softmax without linearising either rotation or normalisation. The resulting predictions achieve 95.36--96.52% sign accuracy
record.title: Exact Finite Attention Responses From RoPE Derivatives
